500-4923-5913.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
500-4923-5913.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Pinnacle Monk and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Pinnacle Monk tokens enter, they each trigger, returning Cabal Ritual and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2645-4667-5640.easyPrerequisites: Elvish Aberration doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-4667-5640.description:
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, targeting Elvish Aberration.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Staff of Domination's ability, targeting Elvish Aberration.
Resolve the first Staff of Domination ability, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Holding priority, activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Resolve the second Staff of Domination ability, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

215-1849-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-1849-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1479-2841-5671-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-5671-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and The Necrobloom trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1940-6249-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3668-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3668-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dominion Saboteur and Flesh Duplicate each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3668-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

348-1152-4867-6112-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-4867-6112-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Cormela and any creature not part of the combo.
When Cormela dies, it and Fumulus triggers.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

3967-7804--5.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
3967-7804--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat

1806-2060-4050-6774-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Loading Zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

141-2562-4050.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

804-1084-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Sakashima the Impostor.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4865-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vesuvan Shapeshifter
4865-5299-5466.description:
Cast Vesuvan Shapeshifter by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Vesuvan Shapeshifter into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuvan Shapeshifter's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Vesuvan Shapeshifter's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Vesuvan Shapeshifter's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

3362-3455.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vizier of Many Faces
3362-3455.description:
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vizier of Many Faces's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5567-5686-6254--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5567-5686-6254--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1247-5963-5986.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-5963-5986.description:
Activate Marvin using Whisperer of the Wilds's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2736-6085-6086-6087.notablePrerequisites: Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
2736-6085-6086-6087.description:
Activate Zedruu the Greathearted by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Altanak to an opponent.
Declare Sentinel as an attacker, forcing Altanak to block it due to Lure.
Holding priority, activate Sentinel an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

1601-4853-5003.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value five or greater.
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
1601-4853-5003.description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing Dross Scorpion or another artifact creature with mana value four or greater, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Illuminor Szeras.
Repeat.

186-467-1379-1978-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness.
186-467-1379-1978-4659.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Pilot, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Shorikai.
Repeat.

1369-2645-4306-5112.notablePrerequisites:
Mairsil does not have summoning sickness.
Your devotion to blue is at least three.
1369-2645-4306-5112.description:
Activate Mairsil using Nyx Lotus' ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mairsil using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Mairsil using Quicksilver Elemental's ability by paying {U}, causing it to gain all activated abilities of itself until end of turn.
Repeat.
If desired, you may use any of Staff of Domination's other abilities using Mairsil, and then use Quicksilver Elemental's ability to use them infinitely.

1216-1799-2048-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sengir Autocrat, adding {1}.
When Sengir Autocrat leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, exiling all Serf tokens.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Sengir Autocrat on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Sengir Autocrat into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sengir Autocrat enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating three 0/1 Serf creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Serfs, adding {3}.
Repeat.

678-2034-2060.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4} in four different colors, causing Crystalline Crawler to enter the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} in four different colors.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Crystalline Crawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Crystalline Crawler dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Crystalline Crawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2506-2781.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian.
On ETB, both Felidar Guardian and Molten Echoes trigger; resolve the triggers in that order.
Target a land that ETBs untapped with Felidar Guardian, floating mana and blinking it.
Resolve Molten Echoes' trigger, creating a Felidar Guardian token copy.
Blink the original Felidar Guardian with the token's ETB Blink trigger.
The original Felidar Guardian ETBs, repeating the loop from the top for infinite mana and infinite hasty cat tokens.
